manual: Build with community-apps/plain/install.sh. Prefers CMake; falls back to plain.pro + qmake6. Stock Devuan Excalibur Qt 6.8 is enough; there is no Qt ≥ 6.9 pin.
When apt's qt6-*-dev candidate would downgrade libqt6core, use a matching ~/.local/opt/omaxian-qt6-<mm>/ (same layout as Monologue/Signed). install.sh puts that prefix on PATH / CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH.

Runtime needs qml6-module-qtcore (Main.qml imports QtCore for StandardPaths/StandardKey). If apt cannot match libqt6core, place QtCore under ~/.local/lib/qt6/qml/ — install.sh then wraps ~/.local/bin/plain like Monologue.
Open/Save uses xdg-desktop-portal; install.sh pulls in the GTK backend.
Hyprland corner rounding is skipped when HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE is unset, so corners stay square on i3.
Text size follows [font] base-size in ~/.config/omarchy/shell.toml (Settings → Appearance), then the theme's shell.toml, else 12px.
